events.title: DRAG QUEEN BINGO | 9 September
events.description: Forget nanna bingo - this is full-blown DRAG BINGO CHAOS 💅🎉 Round up your crew and settle in for a wild night of laughs, games and outrageous fun, hosted by the iconic Drag Bingo GC! Featuring epic Drag performances as well as DJ VICES dropping banging tunes throughout the night! 🎶🔥 The party comes to you with our exclusive  Drag Bingo-themed cocktails delivered straight to your table , plus feast your way through the incredible street food vendors at Miami Marketta . Loud, proud and totally unforgettable - you’ve been warned 😉 MA15+ event This is a safe, inclusive and accepting space. No children or babies — strictly no exceptions.

events.title: VIVA LA SALSA - September 10
events.description: Get ready to dance the night away at Viva La Salsa , Hola Marketta's free monthly salsa social. Whether you're stepping onto the dance floor for the first time or looking to refine your moves, everyone is welcome. Kick off the evening with a free Advanced Salsa lesson at 5:30pm , followed by a free Beginners lesson at 6:30pm . From 7pm , the dance floor comes alive with social dancing, great music and an unbeatable atmosphere. Make a night of it with Miami Marketta's famous street food, fully stocked bars and vibrant laneway vibes. Grab your friends, bring your dancing shoes and join us for an evening of Latin rhythms, good company and plenty of fun. Schedule 💃 Advanced Lesson: 5:30pm 🕺 Beginners Lesson: 6:30pm 🎶 Social Dancing: From 7:00pm Free entry. Everyone is welcome.

events.title: NO CIGAR
events.description: NO CIGAR are bringing their brand of ‘semi rock’ to Australia this spring, with thirteen lively shows on the cards for their biggest run in Australia to date . NO CIGAR have carved out a unique niche blending indie, surf, and alternative rock into a sound that's as rhythm-driven as it is emotionally resonant, earning a fiercely loyal following across Australia, the UK, the US and Europe. They are no strangers to the Australian shores and audiences, making this their fourth headline excursion across the ditch. Spanning the breadth of their catalogue, the show will likely include a few unreleased numbers, giving Australia the first sneak peak of what’s next for NO CIGAR.

events.title: CHERRY PICKERS MARKET - SEPTEMBER 12
events.description: Cherry Pickers Market is open to all sellers — from curated vintage to wardrobe clear-outs, vinyl slingers to local makers. It’s all about bringing the community together and getting behind the secondhand and slow fashion movement. Hosted at one of Gold Coast’s most iconic venues — Miami Marketta. We’ve been so lucky to call this place home since 2020. Now held once a month on a Saturday from 10AM-2PM. We can’t wait to see you at the next Cherry Pickers Market!

events.title: MANEVA & FABIO BRAZZA + TÚLIO - Brazilian Day
events.description: SUNDAY 13th of September | Miami Marketta | Gold Coast For the first time as part of the Brazilian Day Experience, one of Brazil's most beloved bands, Maneva, brings their acclaimed live show to the Gold Coast for a special night celebrating Brazilian music, culture, and community. With a career spanning over two decades, MANEVA has become one of the biggest names in Brazilian reggae, captivating millions of fans through their uplifting melodies, powerful lyrics, and unforgettable live performances. Known for hits such as Lágrimas de Alegria, Luz Que Me Traz Paz, and O Destino Não Quis, the band has built a devoted following throughout Brazil and around the world, delivering a unique blend of reggae, rock, and Brazilian rhythms that continues to inspire audiences of all ages. Sharing the stage is renowned Brazilian rapper, poet, and songwriter FÁBIO BRAZZA, one of the most respected voices in contemporary Brazilian hip-hop. Celebrated for his intelligent lyricism, storytelling, and powerful social commentary, Fábio Brazza's performances combine energy, authenticity, and artistry in a way that resonates deeply with audiences. Opening the celebration is Gold Coast-based Brazilian artist TÚLIO, whose music reflects the vibrant spirit of modern Brazil while representing the strength and passion of Australia's Brazilian community. More than just a concert, Brazilian Day Experience is a celebration of everything that makes Brazil unique. Enjoy authentic Brazilian food, cultural experiences, art, community connections, and an atmosphere filled with the colours, flavours, rhythms, and energy that have made Brazilian culture famous worldwide. Whether you're Brazilian, have Brazilian roots, or simply love great music and cultural experiences, this is your opportunity to be part of an unforgettable event bringing the heart of Brazil to the Gold Coast. One day. Three incredible artists. One unforgettable Brazilian celebration. Presented by Tropical Lab and Folia's Entertainment.

events.title: LIFE DRAWING SESSIONS - SEPTEMBER 16
events.description: Join us for a curated evening of Life Drawing with Live Music in Studio 56 at the Miami Marketta. At Life Drawing Sessions our focus is not on the outcome of your drawing, rather it is about the process of giving into the act of creating with music and muse. This event embraces people of all drawing levels from novice to maestro.

events.title: Forró No Marketta - September 17
events.description: Forró No Marketta - Free Monthly Dance Night Step into the rhythm of Brazil with Forró No Marketta, a free monthly night of music, dancing and good vibes. Kick things off with a free forró lesson at 6pm, then enjoy social dancing and a DJ set from 7pm. Forró is a lively and playful partner dance from the North of Brazil, perfect for beginners and seasoned dancers alike. With street food, great company and our signature Brazilian caipirinhas flowing, it’s the ultimate midweek escape. Join us every third Thursday of the month and experience something a little different.

events.title: VENEZUELA FUNDRAISER CONCERT
events.description: Stand with Venezuela: Community Fundraiser In the wake of the recent earthquake, it's time for us to show up and show out. Join us for an event fueled by community, compassion, and action! Let's turn our collective good energy into tangible support during these incredibly difficult times.   What to Expect Live Music by:                  No Nation                Mango Matic                DJ Juan Carlexx                DJ Victor Lopes     Incredible artists bringing the healing power of sound. Great Food and Drinks: Grab a plate, connect with the community, and fuel up for a good cause. Tattoo Raffle: Try your luck to win a fresh piece of ink from Voltio Tattoo (worth $1200)*. Good Energy: A community coming together in solidarity to make a real difference. All proceeds go directly to Venezuelan earthquake relief efforts. Come through, give back, and share the love! Let's turn our good energy into tangible support. Date: 18th September, from 6pm  Location: Miami Marketta

events.title: CHUTNEY
events.description: "Beloved Gold Coast five-piece Chutney are dusting off their instruments and returning to the stage for a massive night of indie rock at Miami Marketta on Saturday, September 19th. After spending a little too long away from the stage, the boys are back and ready to make some noise in one of the Gold Coast’s favourite live music rooms. Joining us for the night are local legends Tomorrow’s Forecast and Mermaid Waters, with one more very special support act still to be announced! Expect loud guitars, questionable behaviour, cold beers and a healthy serving of condiment rock."

events.title: THE OPEN FONDA
events.description: 🇨🇱 THE OPEN FONDA ‘26 — The Biggest Chilean Fonda on the Gold Coast 📅 Sunday 20 September 2026 ⏰ 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM  📍 Miami Marketta The Open Fonda takes over Miami Marketta for a full day family-friendly Chilean celebration, bringing together music, food, dance and culture in a vibrant community atmosphere — all in the heart of the Gold Coast. 🎶 Live Music & DJs 🎺 Live cumbia & dancefloor favourites by Kachimbaz (Sydney) 🎸 Chilean rock & pop classics by Mr. Veneno (Brisbane) 🎧 Firing up the party: DJ Dabito (Gold Coast) & DJ Maria Pina (Sydney) 💃 Traditional Chilean Cueca performance by Danza Montun (Brisbane) 🍴 Food & Drinks 🥟 A Chilean classics food feast — empanadas, choripán, mote con huesillo and much more. 🍹 Sip and celebrate like at home with piscolas, terremotos, Chilean wine and more. ❤️ Feeling Chileno de Corazón? 💃 Sign up for our Cueca Contest , show your moves and celebrate our traditions together. 🎨🎯 Dive into a full day of traditional games, arts & crafts for kids and plenty of fun for all ages. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Bring the family, come with friends, enjoy great food, dance all afternoon and let’s celebrate Chile together. 🎟️ Limited tickets available ✨ Produced by Casa Babylon
